text:
Priya Patel: Heads-up — AcmeCorp invoice autopay failed for multiple customers this morning. Customer portal shows decline reason `insufficient_funds` but they insist funds were available. Payments logs show repeated SCA/3DS activity and an ACS error 429. payment_id=pay_0Xc3 trace=abcd-1234

Liam Chen: Can you paste the logs/snippet for the 429 + the decline payload? also which acquirer/ACS provider?

Priya Patel: pasted below (sanitized):
```
2026-02-14T09:12:02Z INFO payment=pay_0Xc3 attempt=1 3ds_session=3ds_78 started
2026-02-14T09:12:58Z WARN payment=pay_0Xc3 acs_response=timeout challenge_window=60s
2026-02-14T09:13:01Z INFO payment=pay_0Xc3 client_retry duplicate_submit=true
2026-02-14T09:13:05Z ERROR payment=pay_0Xc3 acs_http_status=429 acs_code=rate_limited trace=abcd-1234
2026-02-14T09:13:06Z INFO payment=pay_0Xc3 final_decline=insufficient_funds acq_response=decline
```
ACS provider is via our payments partner (3rd-party ACS).

Nina K: This looks like a classic 3DS race + ACS throttling: client retried (duplicate_submit) while an earlier challenge was still in progress -> ACS sees multiple session opens and starts throttling, then eventually returns a hard decline from the acquirer. The `insufficient_funds` at the end is probably the downstream acquirer fallback when SCA flow fails.

Liam Chen: makes sense. Any repro steps from the portal? Priya, did you see double-clicks or network flaps?

Priya Patel: Customer says they clicked once, but their portal has a spinner and sometimes customers click again after ~10s. We can repro locally by rapidly firing two POST /payments with same cart id but no idempotency. Repro script attached in DM.

Aaron M: Quick mitigation ideas: enforce idempotency on the client or server to ignore second submit while a 3DS session is open; increase the local 3DS challenge timeout window (we use 60s) to 120s so clients have longer to complete challenge; add exponential backoff before re-issuing a 3DS session. Also set a server-side check: if there's an active 3ds_session for payment_id, reject new session creation with 409 and surface friendly message to user.

Nina K: Agreed. Also worth asking payments partner if their ACS will accept `session_id` reuse or has strict session uniqueness. If they enforce uniqueness, duplicate opens will always trigger rate limiting. We should capture `acs_challenge_id` in logs and correlate.

Liam Chen: Action items: 
- Priya: collect 3 recent payment_ids + full traces and forward to payments partner (ticket) — due EOD.
- Aaron: quick server-side patch to return 409 when active 3ds_session exists (short PR) — can you estimate?
- Nina: open SRE/partner escalation if partner-side throttle is frequent.

Priya Patel: forwarding traces now. examples: pay_0Xc3, pay_0Zb9, pay_0Yq2. also customer provided network HAR where second submit fired at +11s.

billing-bot: Support ticket created with payments-partner: PARTNER-9842. Severity=high. Linked incidents: none. ETA partner response: 24-48h.

eng-sre-bot: Noted. Pager duty notified for spikes in acs_429 rates. Threshold: >5/minute.

Aaron M: I can get a small patch out in ~2 hours to short-circuit duplicate session opens (server-side 409). Will include a quick client-friendly message: "A 3DS challenge is already in progress. Please complete the authentication or wait 30s before retrying."

Liam Chen: After patch, run canary on dedicated infra + measure acs_429 and overall decline rate. If it drops we keep the change. Also add metric `payments.3ds.duplicate_submits` to Console.

Priya Patel: Thanks — will update AcmeCorp CSM with mitigations in next 30min and ask them to tell affected users to avoid double-clicking for now. Will also ask for any additional customer evidence.

Nina K: Longer-term: consider UI guardrails (disable pay button after first click, spinner + countdown), and a replay-safe idempotency token tied to checkout session so accidental resubmits don't create new 3DS sessions. Also add a regression test in e2e payments flows that simulates duplicate submits.

Priya Patel: ack. I'll file a follow-up ticket for UX and e2e. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
